claim_summary: For any nonnegative even-supported four-site signature, even-windability is characterized by B=(sum_i h_i-A)/2>=0 and sum_i max(0,h_i-B)<=A, with A=f(empty)f(all) and h_i the three complementary pair products. The seven-edge coupled six-site example satisfies the criterion and has an explicit witness; a Delta-positive synthetic function fails the extra bound.
remaining_gate: No full six-site even-windability, conservative extension for general F, microscopic energy comparison, or sampler is proved.
